authorship.additional_inputs: Retained primary text excerpts embedded in frozen source packets; exposed historical audit natural-use observations N01/N02 and prior v2 goal debt ledger. No new runtime/native/evaluator code read; no NABT producer executed.

method.projection: Exact JSON pointer to typed value assertions, separate from independently declared required positive goals. No wildcard or type coercion. Source and binding invariants are additional evaluator checks.
method.cells: Literal A116 word and realized-tail arrays hand-derived from carrier positions and declared states. The helper only assembles literals and prepends the separately hand-authored QAMA array; no source classifier, normalizer, acquisition function or transition simulator generated expected values.
method.scope: Known finite lexical scope preimplementation independence, not a secret held-out vocabulary. Historical conditionals and natural-use debts are disclosed exposed diagnostics.
method.coverage: Positive required goals remain misses when bounded-contract expectations correctly defer. Candidate retrieval, grammatical person, nominal predication, connected realization, bounded natural reading, actual intention and complete sound-to-meaning chains remain separate goal kinds.
method.negative: No unique grammatical person from ambiguous ta; no nominal admission on agreement/case/whole-input failure; no arbitrary article/sun/contact license; no lexical sense selection from quotation, absent cue, unknown subject or context plausibility.
method.limitations: Finite case evidence only; no all-Arabic completeness, acoustic validation, actual author intention or world truth. Boundary/mutation/resource tests belong to separate unit-test denominators.
method.chronology: Specification/source commit precedes matrix commit and runtime. Preserve first evaluation attempt including failure, then label subsequent attempts exposed.
